notes.title: First Announcement / Free Content Update!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Thank you to all who have taken interest in The Hierophant and a big thank you to all who have enjoyed the game so far. With the Launch Sale coming to an end soon, I've decided to include the games soundtrack as a free bonus, this should be available soon.

-Have you found a bug? Do you have a suggestion or feedback of any kind? Share it in the Official Discord!

-Version 1.0 release does have a few noticeable bugs that may affect core gameplay. These will be addressed.

-I do plan to release content updates.
These updates will bring [spoiler]New Quests, Items, Creatures, and eventually 
A ̷F̢R͟EE DLC̴ E̴X̛P̧AN̡S̀IÓN̷ ͟[/spoiler]!

Take care and may you prosper!
